neighbours.label: Event nouns after ordinal or recurrence modifiers, especially numbered visits and readings.
fire: During her second visit to the gallery, Maya examined the portrait.
His third trip to the island lasted a week.
On the second reading of the letter, I understood the joke.
Their fourth visit to the archive uncovered the missing record.
The first time she entered the studio, the lights were off.
Each new visit to the garden reveals a different flower.
The second trip to the market was much shorter.
On his third reading of the poem, he noticed the rhythm.
quiet: During her quiet visit to the gallery, Maya examined the portrait.
His short trip to the island lasted a week.
On the careful reading of the letter, I understood the joke.
Their recent visit to the archive uncovered the missing record.
When she entered the studio, the lights were off.
A leisurely visit to the garden reveals a different flower.
The evening trip to the market was much shorter.
On his attentive reading of the poem, he noticed the rhythm.

notes: Card suggests event recurrence rather than visits alone. Fresh matched controls retain each event but remove the recurrence modifier. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory sentences are disjoint from this preregistered test.
